resources.string: Old mappings cannot run in this version. Select the destination again. Existing files stay where they are; nothing is moved or deleted.
Final destination: %1$s. Relative paths start here; no extra subfolder is created.
Checked %1$d paths · %2$d automatic actions · %3$d conflicts · %4$d deferred
Phone: %1$s · PC: %2$s. Both versions are retained until you choose.
All files access granted. Also select and authorize the exact sync folder.
Safe conditional file replacement and timestamps require All files access plus your selected SAF folder. Without both, file sync is deferred; no unsafe overwrite is used.

At most 100 receipts are shown. Original files remain beside their targets. Only confirmed, unchanged backups can be removed. Restore requires an unchanged live result and keeps its replacement. Sync baselines stay unchanged.
Only this verified receipt will be processed. Other files are retained.
This pairing is no longer valid. Pair again if the device was revoked.
Upgrade the PC app for all paired-device sync capabilities. Individual PC permissions are no longer needed.

Enabled mappings sync automatically. Folder events trigger foreground sync; background checks use Android WorkManager (15 minutes or later). Offline, Doze and force-stop can delay sync. Changes compare file size and exact modification time.
Automatic file sync is cancelled until Sync now or a mapping is enabled again. Paused mappings stay paused.
